coordinate_convention.axes: Runtime: X east, Y up, Z south; runtime.z = -blender.y
coordinate_convention.y: terrain surface height minus embed; crowns are intentionally sunk into terrain
coordinate_convention.embed: positive metres already subtracted from terrain surface height

field_docs.y: runtime Y position in metres, already terrain_height - embed
field_docs.variant: tree asset id: tree_oak_a, tree_beech_a, tree_willow_a or tree_ancient_a
field_docs.priority: 0..1 deterministic streaming/culling importance; instances are sorted descending
field_docs.embed: positive metres sunk below the bilinear R16 terrain surface

assumptions: forest_macro is a canopy occupancy/opacity field; density_scale is an optional planting-density calibration knob (1.0 keeps the macro distribution exact)
slope is sampled by central differences from the full-resolution R16 heightfield rather than from the macro map's cell-averaged 2 m slope raster
hydrology distance/level are bilinearly sampled from the same 4 m analytical lake/river field used by build_macromap.py
path and monument exclusions are coarse centreline/circle clearances; current monuments mostly lie inside the hard-excluded hand-dressed slice
variable spacing uses the larger local spacing of each pair, so density transitions are conservative
